Claims, direct sources, method declarations, configurations and aggregate/key results are integrated here. Detailed original observations and private originals stay in the linked original module and native relational tables. No historical experiments were rerun by this import. This is the original IPv6 module assessment; the later owner-workspace follow-ups remain separate and unchanged.
